body:
Dear friend,

What a week we've had: lambs, trail stones, and the top of the mountain!

Before you go home for the festival, why not write a letter to send down with the mule? Come up to the hut.
summary: Write a letter home from the mountain.
done: Your letter is on its way down the mountain!

tasks.where: at the coop by your house
in the grove behind the chapel
